text.name: rhm_help_overview_1
text.text: Realistic Harvesting completely removes artificial hard-coded speed limits. Live engine strain is calculated honestly via a physics formula: accounting for machine base motion, header drive (proportional to cutter width), threshing and chopping friction, crop stand density, and root crop soil drag. When facing dense swaths, the hydrostatic transmission smoothly decelerates the combine to prevent drum choking.

text.name: rhm_help_overview_2
text.text: Dense, oily, or fibrous crops (canola, sunflower, corn) exert significantly more resistance on the rotor than dry wheat or oats. Harvesting speed will naturally adapt (e.g. 4–6 km/h in thick canola instead of 8–10 km/h). Aim for an engine load between 85% and 92% on the HUD for peak harvesting throughput without grain loss.

text.name: rhm_help_hud_1
text.text: Boarding a combine activates a modern telemetry dashboard. Two layout modes are available: Compact (minimal bar next to the game speedometer) and Expanded (full 4-cell HUD: Engine Load, Cruise Speed, Field Yield, and Throughput in t/h). Switch modes anytime via the ESC settings menu or by clicking. Left-clicking the speed cell toggles to Sieve Grain Loss (Tier 2+), while clicking yield toggles to Live Crop Moisture (Tier 3+).

text.name: rhm_help_hud_2
text.text: You can place the HUD anywhere on screen: right-click in the cab to activate the mouse pointer and drag the HUD to your preferred location. Position is saved per savegame. Customize metric (t/ha) or imperial (bu/ac) units, overload warning chime volume, and HUD background style in the ESC menu.

text.name: rhm_help_hud_3_load
text.text: Cell 1: Engine Load. Green indicates safe load (<85%), yellow is optimal operating range (85–105%), red is overload (>105%) with risk of grain loss.

text.name: rhm_help_hud_3_yield
text.text: Cell 3: Live field yield of the current patch in tons per hectare (t/ha) or bushels per acre (bu/ac).

text.name: rhm_help_hud_3_productivity
text.text: Cell 4: Combine throughput — processed crop weight in tons per hour (t/h).

text.name: rhm_help_hud_3_moisture
text.text: Cell 3 (Click): Live grain moisture percentage (Tier 3+ with Precision Farming or Moisture System).

text.name: rhm_help_hud_3_loss
text.text: Cell 2 (Click): Sieve grain loss percentage (unlocked with Tier 2 sensor package).

text.name: rhm_help_hud_3_speed
text.text: Cell 2: Current working speed in km/h or mph, dynamically balanced by the hydrostat.

text.name: rhm_help_calibration_main_text
text.text: Press Right Shift + K inside the vehicle to bring up the in-cab calibration tablet. The top header shows combine model, horsepower, and attached cutter width. Different crops require specific drum RPM, cleaning fan airflow, concave clearance, and sieve openings. Tier 2 enables saving and loading custom crop profiles, while Tier 4 unlocks one-click automated tuning via the AI AUTO button.

text.name: rhm_help_calibration_rotor_text
text.text: Drum RPM and concave clearance determine separation quality. Small grains (wheat, barley) require high speed (700–850 RPM) and narrow concave (8–12 mm) for clean threshing. Fragile crops (corn, soybeans, sunflowers) need lower RPM (350–450 RPM) and wider concaves (25–35 mm) to prevent grain cracking.

text.name: rhm_help_calibration_fan_text
text.text: The cleaning fan blows chaff out of the rear while sieves filter clean grain into the hopper. Light seeds (canola, flax) require gentle airflow (600–650 RPM) to prevent grain from blowing onto the ground. Heavy cob residue in corn requires maximum airflow (1000–1200 RPM) to float trash away.

text.name: rhm_help_calibration_perf_text
text.text: The target load slider sets how aggressively the cruise control pushes the combine (default 88%). Live telemetry cards display Engine Load, Threshing Efficiency %, and Predicted Loss %. High target load speeds up work in clean stands, while moderate load (80–85%) guarantees zero losses and peak fuel economy.

text.name: rhm_help_special_1
text.text: Forage harvesters chop standing corn or pickup grass windrows directly into chase trailers. They feature zero sieve loss. The calibration tablet allows adjusting chopping drum RPM and discharge accelerator blower power.

text.name: rhm_help_special_2
text.text: Potato and sugar beet harvesters overcome heavy soil drag from lifting shares, demanding significant power. The tablet regulates haulm topper speed and sieve conveyor rollers. Cotton pickers and wide-span modular NEXAT platform carriers are also fully supported.

text.name: rhm_help_loss_1
text.text: Grain loss begins gently above 80% engine load. Up to 90% load, losses remain negligible (<0.5%), but climb along an exponential curve past 100%. Operating deep in the red zone (>110%) overloads the cleaning shoe, wasting massive yield and risking severe drum clogging.

text.name: rhm_help_loss_2
text.text: Crop losses in Realistic Harvesting are 100% physical: wasted liters are subtracted directly from the combine grain tank in real time. Misconfigured sieves or drums can waste up to 25% of your crop. Keep an eye on the HUD and calibrate your machine.

text.name: rhm_help_loss_3
text.text: Equipment wear significantly degrades harvesting efficiency. Blunt cutterbar knives shatter standing crop heads (up to +3% loss and +15% PTO drive drag). A worn threshing drum and sieves drop unseparated grain (up to +3% loss). Keep headers and combines well-maintained at the workshop to eliminate wear penalties.

text.name: rhm_help_difficulty_1
text.text: Smart cruise control analyzes crop mass intake and adjusts hydrostatic swash plate displacement smoothly. Entering a new pass features a 2.8s entry timer to let the drum fill without sudden jerks. The combine eases off in dense patches and accelerates smoothly in lighter crop.

text.name: rhm_help_difficulty_2
text.text: When you raise the cutterbar to turn at the field boundary, the speed controller memorizes your operating speed. Lowering the cutter into the next pass immediately resumes that cruise pace without sluggish crawling.

text.name: rhm_help_upgrades_1
text.text: Standard factory baseline for starter harvesters. All drum and sieve adjustments are purely manual. Loss and moisture readouts are not installed on the HUD. Best for budget farm setups.

text.name: rhm_help_upgrades_2
text.text: Installs electronic piezoelectric loss sensors on sieves and rotors (loss % on HUD). Unlocks saving and loading custom calibration profiles in combine memory.

text.name: rhm_help_upgrades_3
text.text: Equips an optical moisture sensor in the clean grain elevator (live moisture % on HUD). Enhances hired worker tuning accuracy to ±4%.

text.name: rhm_help_upgrades_4
text.text: Flagship smart farming suite: unlocks the AI AUTO button in the tablet terminal. The machine automatically dials in ideal settings for the field, eliminates worker error (0%), and halves wet-crop drag penalties.

text.name: rhm_help_moisture_1
text.text: The mod automatically hooks into Moisture System and Precision Farming. Damp straw and wet grain add substantial viscous friction in the rotor, consuming extra power, elevating fuel burn, and requiring wider sieve clearances.

text.name: rhm_help_moisture_2
text.text: Rain, dense fog, and morning/evening dew saturate crop stems. Working in wet conditions significantly lowers harvesting speed and raises clogging risk. Plan primary harvest runs during warm, dry afternoon hours.

text.name: rhm_help_cropsettings_grain_text
text.text: Fully compatible with Giants AI workers, Courseplay (v7+), and AutoDrive. Speed regulation operates at the motor server level so helpers never over-speed or choke the drum. AI workers preserve your manual calibrations.

text.name: rhm_help_cropsettings_forage_text
text.text: • Wheat / Barley: Rotor ~750 RPM, concave 8–12 mm, fan 800–900 RPM, upper sieve 12 mm, lower sieve 6 mm. • Canola: Rotor ~600 RPM, concave 18 mm, fan 600–650 RPM (gentle air prevents blowing seeds out). • Corn / Soybeans: Rotor 350–420 RPM, concave 25–35 mm, fan 1000–1100 RPM, sieves wide open.

text.name: rhm_help_cropsettings_root_text
text.text: • Corn Silage: Chopper drum 1100–1200 RPM, blower 95%. • Grass Silage: Chopper drum 800–900 RPM, blower 80%. • Potatoes / Beets: Sieve rollers ~400 RPM, haulm topper 85% — keep moderate speed to avoid tuber bruising.

text.name: rhm_setting_ai_tuning_long
text.text: Controls how hired workers and Courseplay handle combine calibration. 'Keep Player Settings' strictly respects and retains your adjustments or loaded profiles. 'Always Auto-Tune' recalculates settings based on electronics tier. 'Disabled' prevents helpers from ever changing combine settings.

text.name: rhm_setting_enableTutorials_long
text.text: Show interactive onboarding hints and tips during harvesting.

text.name: rhm_tut_welcome_msg
text.text: Welcome to Realistic Harvesting! Combine speed is dynamically controlled by engine load, crop density, and width. Monitor your HUD and press (Right Shift + K) to open the Calibration Terminal.

text.name: rhm_tut_overload_msg
text.text: The engine is under extreme strain! The hydrostatic transmission is slowing the combine to prevent drum blockage. Raise the cutter or reduce width to relieve pressure.

text.name: rhm_tut_loss_msg
text.text: Grain loss behind the combine is critically high! Threshing rotor or cleaning shoe settings are misaligned. Open (Right Shift + K) to calibrate rotor speed, fan, and sieves.

text.name: rhm_tut_moisture_msg
text.text: Crop moisture is high or rain has begun! Wet straw and grain create immense internal friction, increasing engine load and harvest loss. Work during dry afternoon hours when possible.

text.name: rhm_tut_headland_msg
text.text: When lifting the cutter at headlands, the combine remembers your active harvesting speed. You will seamlessly re-enter rows without sudden braking.

text.name: rhm_tut_upgrade_msg
text.text: Basic combines require manual tuning. Upgrade electronics at the workshop to unlock Sensor Kits (Tier 2), Yield Monitors (Tier 3), or Opti-Harvest AI Autopilot (Tier 4).

text.name: rhm_setting_wear_loss_long
text.text: Simulates grain loss from equipment wear. Dull header knives shatter crop heads (up to +3% loss and +15% power drag). A worn threshing drum and sieves drop unseparated grain (up to +3% loss).

text.name: rhm_tab_trip_desc
text.text: Live telemetry for harvested volume, worked area, average yield, and financial losses for the active field operation.

text.name: rhm_tab_analytics_desc
text.text: Loss distribution, operator efficiency ranking grade, and onboard diagnostic computer recommendations.

text.name: rhm_tab_fleet_desc
text.text: Real-time telemetry, throughput, and status of all harvesters on your farm.

text.name: rhm_tab_settings_desc
text.text: Configure hired worker cruise limiter, volunteer weed generation, and auto-reset options.

text.name: rhm_rank_desc_a
text.text: Loss rate is below 1.5%. Combine setup and speed are perfectly balanced.

text.name: rhm_rank_desc_b
text.text: Loss rate between 1.5% and 3.0%. Consider minor speed or concave adjustments.

text.name: rhm_rank_desc_c
text.text: Loss rate between 3.0% and 4.5%. Reduce speed or inspect header sharpness.

text.name: rhm_rank_desc_d
text.text: Loss rate exceeds 4.5%! Severe sieve overloading or miscalibration detected.

text.name: rhm_advice_perfect
text.text: Harvesting efficiency is optimal. All separation parameters are well-balanced.

text.name: rhm_advice_speed
text.text: Dominant loss from excessive ground speed. Slow down to reduce sieve bed depth.

text.name: rhm_advice_moisture
text.text: Losses driven by high crop moisture or morning dew. Wait for field drying or reduce speed.

text.name: rhm_advice_wear
text.text: Elevated losses due to worn cutter knives or rasp bars. Service equipment at the workshop.

text.name: rhm_advice_slope
text.text: Lateral tilt on slopes causing uneven shoe loading. Reduce speed along side hills.

text.name: rhm_setting_ai_limiter_desc
text.text: Automatically caps cruise speed for hired workers when loss exceeds threshold.

text.name: rhm_setting_ai_threshold_desc
text.text: Maximum acceptable loss percentage before AI helper automatically brakes.

text.name: rhm_setting_volunteer_desc
text.text: Generates weed and volunteer sprouts behind combines in heavy loss zones (>3%).

text.name: rhm_setting_autoreset_desc
text.text: Automatically archive the current operation and reset the field counter when moving to a different field.
